title: ID0421611-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/S7170003961] FC16 trips
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: The charger worked after commissioning. After testing the external emergency stop, everything worked fine, but since a restart, the FC16 trips when you close the door. We have tested this multiple times, and even after removing the external emergency stop, the FC16 still trips after closing the door
Solution: N/A
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-04-29

DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4
SafetyRelay_QA26
RCD/MCB_FB3.2_Automation
SPD_FA1_or_Fuse_FC1_AC-Income
These components are powered by the 24V supply coming from
FC16

At this stage, we recommend checking the following:
Emergency line

additional_info.subject: ID0421611-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/S7170003961]FC16 trips CRM:02681000116
additional_info.body:
Hi guys, good afternoon.
Short summary of today's visit:
Found that the root cause comes from the Emergency circuit
First tested if the External Emergency stop was the source of the problem → removed
FC16 still trips
Bypassed/bridged the FA12 input
FC16 doesn't trip
Bypassed/bridged the FA12 output
FC16 trips
It's clear that the FA12 is faulty and needs replacement. One thing to keep in mind is to check the cables from the external circuit to prevent any possible damage like we see here.
I will assign this ticket to Daniel. Feel free to reach out to me as always, but let me know at least 1 day in advance if you are going to site and need support.
Thanks as always for your support.
Best regards,
Francisco
